README: Independent, public troubleshooting knowledge base for thermoset powder coating applicators, fabricators, production managers, quality inspectors, manufacturers and technical consultants.
Thermoset powder coatings: polyester, epoxy, epoxy-polyester hybrid, polyurethane and other validated thermoset systems. Product-specific instructions always override generic guidance.
Cure schedules are normally based on PART METAL TEMPERATURE (PMT), not simply oven air temperature. Verify the exact product TDS and profile the slowest-heating location.
The app must not tell users to change chemical concentrations, oven settings, electrical parameters or safety controls blindly. It must first ask for context and provide conditional actions.
Rows marked 'Draft' or 'Illustrative' require technical review before being published as authoritative app content.

The cure graphs in this workbook are illustrative heat-up models for app prototyping, not validated production recipes. Actual curves depend on oven design, load, airflow, geometry, starting temperature, part mass, fixtures and product chemistry.

User-provided troubleshooting PDF plus external technical references reviewed during preparation. The source PDF includes electrostatic, reclaim, cured properties, powder application, coverage and cured appearance troubleshooting.
Show symptoms, ask diagnostic questions, rank possible causes, give safe verification checks, then show conditional corrective actions and verification tests.

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Powder does not stick; weak wrap
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: HV supply; electrode damage; powder build-up; poor grounding; unsuitable powder
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Is HV on? Is electrode intact and clean? Check continuity; inspect hanger/conveyor ground; compare virgin vs reclaim
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Clean/replace electrode; verify HV circuit; restore clean metal-to-ground path; review powder suitability
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Stable spray pattern; measured ground continuity per equipment procedure; improved transfer efficiency

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Film shrinks back; bare metal at edges
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Poor ground; excessive powder output; moisture; powder too fine; formulation
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check ground; compare powder output; inspect moisture; review reclaim ratio and particle distribution
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct grounding; reduce powder feed; control booth humidity; review reclaim/particle distribution with supplier
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Uniform edge coverage without pull-away; repeat on test panel

Troubleshooting.Problem / Symptom: Poor penetration into recesses / Faraday cage
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Powder cloud too wide; voltage too high; delivery velocity too high; poor gun placement; poor ground; powder too fine
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect geometry; measure/verify ground; reduce voltage and transport air in controlled increments; inspect gun position
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Narrow spray pattern; reposition gun; adjust voltage/air per equipment instructions; validate on representative part
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Coverage in recess meets specified thickness without excessive edge build

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Powder bounces off; crater-like bare spots
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Voltage too high; gun too close; poor ground; excessive film build; fine powder/reclaim
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Observe at what film build rejection begins; inspect ground; check voltage and distance
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Reduce voltage and/or increase distance; correct ground; control film build; review powder distribution
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: No visible repulsion at target thickness; verify thickness map

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Delivery/transport air too high; output too high; weak charge; unsuitable particle size
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Observe powder cloud and part orientation; compare lower air/output; verify charge
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Reduce transport air/output only within equipment limits; correct charging and ground; consult supplier on powder suitability
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Powder remains attached through transfer to oven

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Gun position; overlap; reciprocator stroke/speed; airflow; defective components
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Map thickness across part; inspect gun alignment and reciprocator timing; observe booth airflow
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Reposition guns; tune overlap and reciprocator; correct spray pattern; address airflow disturbance

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Back side or hidden areas thin
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Grounding; charge; gun angle; powder output; geometry
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Verify ground with suitable meter; inspect electrode; test gun angle and distance
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct ground; check electrode; optimize angle/distance and powder output

Troubleshooting.Problem / Symptom: Powder picks up charge in hose / equipment
Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Powder sticks to hose or equipment
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Dry booth air; frictional transport; poor equipment grounding; powder characteristics
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check grounding of equipment; inspect hose material and wear; check humidity and powder condition
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Ground equipment; review hose material with supplier; control humidity; clean affected path
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Stable feed and no recurring electrostatic buildup

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Excessive output; poor gun positioning; wide pattern; airflow; part spacing
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Measure powder consumption; inspect pattern and airflow; review gun-to-part distance
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Optimize output/pattern/distance; correct airflow and spacing; maintain recovery system
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Reduced wastage without loss of required coverage

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Powder buildup; damaged electrode; contamination; moisture
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect electrode and gun outlet; follow equipment isolation procedure
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Stop and isolate equipment as required; clean/replace parts per OEM instructions
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Stable operation; no arcing; documented maintenance

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Insufficient air volume; kinked/long hose; blocked hose/pump/gun; moisture; contaminated reclaim
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check compressed air flow and moisture; inspect hose routing; clean feed path; inspect sieve
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Restore adequate air; remove kinks; clean/replace blocked components; dry/filter air; inspect reclaim sieve

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Powder will not fluidize; dead zones
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Low fluidizing air; blocked membrane; wet powder; poor flowability; poor storage
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect membrane; check air pressure; check powder caking/moisture; review storage history
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Adjust air per equipment procedure; clean/replace membrane; quarantine compromised powder; verify storage

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Impact fusion; fused powder; moisture; poor flowability; contamination
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect blockage location; check compressed air; inspect pump and hose; examine particles
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Clean/replace hose or venturi; reduce problematic transport conditions; dry/filter air; investigate powder condition
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: No recurring blockage under controlled conditions

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Fused powder at outlet; contamination; impact-fusion particles
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Follow OEM cleaning procedure; inspect pump, hose and powder; check moisture
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Clean according to OEM; replace damaged parts; identify contamination source
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Stable spray pattern after extended run

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Worn feed tube/orifice/deflector; impact fusion; low feed air; blockage
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect wear parts and outlet; compare with known-good gun; verify air supply
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Replace worn parts; clean gun; correct feed air within OEM limits

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Low delivery air; pump wear; blockage; poor fluidization; powder condition
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check pump and air; weigh output over timed interval; inspect hose
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct air/feed path; service pump; restore fluidization; review powder condition

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Excessive feed setting; pump calibration; high transport air
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Weigh output; check settings and calibration; inspect powder cloud
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Reduce output in controlled increments; recalibrate if required
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Target thickness achieved with stable output

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Open packaging; high humidity; wet compressed air; warm/cold cycling
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check storage and package condition; inspect air dryer/filter; sieve sample
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Quarantine or condition powder per supplier; improve storage and air treatment

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Foreign particles; shade or texture defects
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Virgin contamination; reclaim sieve failure; booth/hanger dirt; plant air
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect virgin and reclaim separately; check sieve; inspect booth and hangers
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Replace/repair sieve; clean booth/conveyor; isolate contamination source; use fresh/sieved powder
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: No unacceptable foreign material in sample

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Poor dryer; failed coalescing filter; condensate; plant air carryover
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Drain and inspect filters; perform air quality check; compare with clean source
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Service dryer/filters; prevent condensate entry; hold affected powder/parts for evaluation
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Air quality meets equipment and process requirements

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Poor cleaning; conversion coating failure; under-cure; substrate change; incompatible product
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Identify substrate; review pretreatment bath/process; inspect failure interface; verify cure and thickness
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct cleaning/pretreatment; verify drying/drainage; confirm cure using PMT profile; consult supplier
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Adhesion test passes agreed method and specification

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Surface contamination; poor pretreatment; under-cure; incompatible substrate; moisture
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect interface; compare pretreated/unpretreated panels; review bath records and cure profile
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct root cause based on evidence; do not simply increase oven temperature without verification
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Repeat adhesion and environmental exposure checks as applicable

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Inadequate degreasing; handling; contaminated racks; lubricant carryover
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Water-break/cleanliness check where applicable; inspect handling and pretreatment stages
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct degreasing and handling; clean racks; verify rinse/dry stages

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Incorrect chemical concentration, temperature, time, pH, contamination, rinse quality
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Review bath records and supplier limits; inspect coating uniformity; verify rinse water
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Bring process into chemical supplier specification; correct rinse and drying
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Pretreatment meets process specification and performance test

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Insufficient rinse; poor drainage; contaminated rinse water
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect drainage and carryover; check rinse quality and stage flow
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Improve rinsing and drainage; maintain bath and rinse controls
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: No visible residue; required performance achieved

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Poor dry-off; trapped water in joints; inadequate drainage
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect hollow sections, seams, corners; verify dry-off conditions
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Improve part orientation, drainage and dry-off; do not coat wet parts
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Parts visibly dry and defect-free after cure

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Unsuitable pretreatment; zinc surface condition; passivation; moisture; cure
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Identify galvanized finish and pretreatment route; inspect surface; review supplier guidance
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Use validated galvanized preparation process; confirm compatibility and cure

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Porosity; oil/contaminants in pores; moisture; trapped gas
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect casting history; test preheat/outgassing method; examine blister locations
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Use validated outgassing/preheat process; control film thickness; consult powder supplier

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Weld residue; heat scale; salts; geometry; incomplete cleaning
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect welds and HAZ; verify cleaning and pretreatment access
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Improve weld cleaning and preparation; confirm pretreatment coverage

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Same powder behaves differently on different lots
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Alloy/steel grade; surface finish; oil; thickness; prior treatment
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Compare substrate certificates and surface condition; run controlled panel
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Validate process for each substrate family; document approved route

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: PMT not achieved; insufficient time at PMT; thick mass; line speed; oven imbalance
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Attach thermocouples to thin and thick/slow locations; compare with product TDS; verify thickness
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Adjust oven/line only after profile; ensure product TDS cure window is achieved
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Required cure verification and performance tests pass

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Yellowing; gloss loss; brittleness; color shift
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Excessive PMT/time; slow line; hot spots; thin sections exposed too long
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Profile hottest and thinnest areas; compare with TDS upper limits; inspect oven zones
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Reduce excessive exposure while maintaining minimum cure; tune line/oven after profile

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Part mass/geometry; shielding; airflow; mixed loads; oven hot/cold zones
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Profile multiple locations; include thick bosses, corners, lower rack and shielded areas
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Reorient/load parts; improve airflow or oven balance; adjust cycle based on slowest point
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: All critical locations meet cure requirements

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Overbake; underbake; formulation; pigment sensitivity; thickness; contamination
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Compare batch and retained panel; profile PMT; measure color and gloss; verify film thickness
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Use product-specific cure window; control heat exposure; check formulation and contamination
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Color difference within agreed ΔE/tolerance and gloss range

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Uneven cure; thickness variation; contamination; mixed powder; substrate variation
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Map gloss and thickness; profile locations; inspect powder and booth cleanliness
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct cure uniformity, thickness, contamination or product mismatch

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Film too thin; heat-up too slow/fast; powder particle distribution; moisture; formulation
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Measure film thickness; profile heat-up; inspect powder condition; compare control panel
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct thickness and thermal profile; consult supplier before changing formulation

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Cracks or failure in impact/bend test
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Under-cure; excessive thickness; substrate; powder chemistry
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Verify PMT/time; measure thickness; confirm test method and substrate
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct cure/thickness or product selection based on evidence

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Under-cure; wrong powder system; excessive exposure; test mismatch
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Verify cure; review product chemical-resistance claims; confirm reagent and exposure conditions
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct cure or product selection; do not generalize from another chemistry

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Under-cure; formulation; thickness; test method
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Verify cure profile and test method; compare with product TDS
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct cure or review product suitability

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: First parts differ from steady-state parts
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Excessive load; door openings; airflow; heat capacity
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Profile first, middle and last load positions; record load mass and spacing
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Control load pattern and oven recovery; validate with profile

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Thin sections overbaked while thick sections undercured
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Different heat-up rates; shared cycle; part geometry
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Profile thin and thick locations simultaneously; inspect color/gloss differences
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Separate loads or use validated staged/preheat strategy; consult powder supplier
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Both thin and thick locations meet cure and appearance limits

Troubleshooting.Problem / Symptom: Oven temperature display disagrees with part
Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Controller reads target but part fails
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Sensor location; calibration; thermal lag; airflow; load
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Use calibrated profiling equipment; compare air and PMT records
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Calibrate/repair oven; set cycle from part profile and TDS

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Low output; fast line; poor transfer; geometry; measurement error
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Measure at multiple points; check gauge calibration and substrate; review output/line speed
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct application settings and process; verify with measurement map

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Runs; orange peel; poor fit; cure difficulty
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: High output; repeated passes; slow line; edge build; measurement error
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Map thickness; inspect corners/edges; check output and passes
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Reduce build or adjust application; avoid assuming thicker is always better
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Thickness within specification and appearance acceptable

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Gun position; reciprocator mismatch; airflow; geometry; grounding
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Create thickness grid; inspect guns/reciprocator and airflow
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Reposition/tune equipment; control loading and grounding

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Electrostatic field; voltage; powder output; film shrinkage; geometry
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect voltage, distance, film build and edge geometry
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Tune voltage/distance/output; validate on actual geometry
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Edges meet coating requirement without defects

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Faraday cage; spray angle; cloud width; air velocity
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect gun path and voltage; verify ground; compare narrow pattern
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Use suitable pattern/deflector and controlled settings; reposition gun

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Gauge calibration; substrate effect; roughness; location; operator technique
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check calibration and reference standards; repeat at same locations
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Standardize measurement procedure and training

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Film too thin; heat-up rate; particle distribution; moisture; formulation; cure cycle
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Measure thickness; inspect powder condition; profile heat-up; compare approved panel
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct thickness/profile; consult supplier for particle/formulation issue
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Visual standard and gloss/texture criteria met

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Silicone/oil; incompatible material; poor pretreatment; mixed powder; booth contamination
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect air, lubricants, cleaning products, substrate and powder; run controlled panel
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Eliminate contamination source; clean equipment; quarantine affected powder; validate pretreatment
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: No recurring craters in control panel

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Porous casting; moisture; trapped gas; thick film; powder moisture; compressed air
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect substrate porosity and moisture; measure thickness; review preheat/outgassing
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Use validated preheat/outgassing; control thickness; dry powder/air; consult supplier

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Moisture; poor adhesion; outgassing; corrosion; contamination
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Identify whether blister is substrate-side or coating-side; inspect pretreatment and exposure
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct moisture/pretreatment/outgassing and product suitability

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Dirty substrate; booth; powder; hangers; pretreatment sludge
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect particle under magnification; trace source; check booth and powder sieve
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Clean process; sieve or replace powder; correct pretreatment sludge

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Cross-contamination with different formulation; over/under-cure; thickness variation
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Compare affected and unaffected areas; inspect powder changeover and cure
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Clean equipment; isolate incompatible powder; verify cure and thickness

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Insufficient film; incorrect heat-up; powder formulation; moisture; contamination
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Profile PMT/heat-up; measure thickness; inspect powder storage
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Correct process variables; consult supplier for product-specific action

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Insufficient cooling; stacking; contact points; poor handling
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect timing and contact surfaces; measure part temperature before packing
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Improve handling, spacing and cooling; protect contact points
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: No unacceptable marks after handling test

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Different product/batch; film thickness; cure; substrate; gloss; measurement conditions
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Compare retained standards; measure color under controlled conditions; profile cure
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Use approved batch and process; control thickness/cure; investigate batch variation

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Gun settings; reclaim ratio; part orientation; thickness; cure; effect pigment orientation
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Compare virgin/reclaim; map thickness; review application direction and cure
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Follow product-specific application and reclaim instructions; validate panel

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Torn sieve; dirty booth; conveyor/hangers; parts; plant air
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect sieve and booth; compare virgin/reclaim sample
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Repair sieve; clean booth/conveyor; isolate contaminated reclaim

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Incomplete cleaning; hoses/guns/booth/filter residue
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Perform changeover checklist; inspect dead zones and recovery system
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Clean according to validated changeover procedure; segregate first-run powder

Troubleshooting.User wording / aliases: Appearance or flow changes with reclaim
Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Uncontrolled reclaim ratio; particle-size shift; contamination; overbake particles
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Record ratio; test flow and appearance; inspect sieve
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Set approved reclaim ratio; sieve and monitor; consult supplier
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Stable quality across approved reclaim ratio

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Blinded filters; clogged final filters; open area; excessive feed
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check pressure drop, filters, reverse cleaning, booth openings and feed
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Clean/replace filters; correct leakage; control feed/openings
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Airflow and containment meet equipment specification

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Impact fusion; heat exposure; contaminated powder path
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Inspect pump and hose; check hot spots and powder age
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Remove source; clean/replace components; sieve or replace powder

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Humidity; heat; long storage; damaged packaging
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Review storage temperature/humidity and package integrity; sieve sample
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Store sealed in supplier-recommended conditions; quarantine compromised powder

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Age; storage excursions; opened bags; contamination
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check lot and storage history; compare with retained/known-good sample
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Use supplier-approved disposition; do not assume old powder is usable

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Thermal cycling; condensation; caking; flow changes
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Review warehouse conditions and acclimatization; inspect package
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Condition powder as supplier recommends; improve storage

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Paint buildup; grease; worn contacts; poor contact pressure
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Measure grounding at representative hangers; inspect contact points
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Strip/clean/replace hangers; maintain contact points

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Dryer/filter failure; condensate; poor maintenance
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check drains, filters and air quality; inspect affected equipment
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Repair air treatment; hold affected powder/parts for evaluation

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: Powder temperature; booth humidity; filter loading; gun wear; oven drift
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Trend thickness, gloss, color, air pressure, PMT and defect counts
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Use trend-based maintenance and process checks
Troubleshooting.Verification / acceptance: Process capability and defect rate stable

Troubleshooting.Likely causes to investigate: No lot, cure profile, thickness map or pretreatment record
Troubleshooting.Diagnostic questions / checks: Check records available for affected batch
Troubleshooting.Conditional corrective actions: Implement batch/lot and process record fields in app

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Batch is lighter, darker, yellower, redder or bluer
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Cure temperature/time; film thickness; product/batch variation; substrate; contamination
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Compare retained standard; measure under controlled lighting; map thickness; profile PMT; verify lot
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Control cure and thickness; verify product lot; clean equipment; consult manufacturer for formulation issue
Colour_Variation.Verification: Color measurement against agreed ΔE/tolerance and approved panel

Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Overbake; hot spots; excessive total thermal exposure; formulation sensitivity; contamination
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Profile hottest and thinnest points; compare oven zones; check product TDS
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Reduce excessive exposure while meeting cure; correct hot spots; use validated product option
Colour_Variation.Verification: Color and gloss within approved limit

Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Over-cure; thickness; pigment sensitivity; contamination; substrate show-through
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Compare pre-cure appearance only as a process clue; measure cured film and PMT
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Correct cure and thickness; inspect contamination; validate product suitability

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Same code looks different across lots
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Raw material/pigment variation; cure; thickness; substrate; measurement conditions
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Compare lot certificates/retained panels; run same substrate and same cure; measure ΔE
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Quarantine suspect lot; standardize process; contact manufacturer

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Top, bottom, edge and center differ
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Uneven thickness; cure gradients; airflow; gun pattern; geometry
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Map color, gloss, thickness and PMT at same locations
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Correct application overlap, loading and cure uniformity

Colour_Variation.Colour issue: Variation between thin and thick sections
Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Thin area differs from heavy section
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Different heat-up rates; overbake of thin areas; undercure of thick areas
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Profile both locations simultaneously; map color/gloss and thickness
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Separate loads or validate staged profile; use product with suitable cure window
Colour_Variation.Verification: Both sections meet color and performance requirements

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Same shade appears different due to gloss
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Gloss variation; surface texture; film thickness; cure
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Measure gloss and color; inspect texture; compare at same viewing angle
Colour_Variation.Verification: Color and gloss both within limits

Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Gun direction; effect pigment orientation; reclaim; thickness; spray pattern
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Compare virgin/reclaim; inspect gun orientation and part position; map thickness
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Follow product-specific application method; control reclaim and pattern

Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Different substrate; different orientation; different cure history; different lot
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Coat matched panels together; record substrate and profile
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Standardize lot, substrate, loading and cure; avoid mixing uncontrolled batches

Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Surface preparation; film thickness; different cure; aged surrounding coating
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Identify original coating and recoat compatibility; compare gloss and texture
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Use approved repair/recoat system; validate on sample

Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Previous shade in hose/booth/reclaim; incompatible powder
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Inspect changeover; compare virgin vs reclaim; sieve sample
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Clean changeover; segregate first-run powder; repair recovery contamination

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Fading, chalking or yellowing in service
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: UV exposure; product suitability; film thickness; cure; environment
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Identify resin/system and exposure; compare retained control; measure gloss/color
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Use product rated for exposure; verify cure and thickness; investigate environment

Colour_Variation.Colour issue: Colour difference due to film thickness
Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Thick and thin areas differ in shade
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Optical effect; hiding; pigment concentration per area; gloss/texture
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Measure thickness at color points; compare against approved range
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Stabilize application thickness and spray pattern
Colour_Variation.Verification: Color stable within target thickness window

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Same powder differs on steel vs aluminium/galvanized
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Substrate reflectance; pretreatment; surface texture; primer/base coat
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Run side-by-side panels on each substrate with same cure
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Create substrate-specific approved standards; validate product suitability

Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Different illuminant/observer; geometry; gloss; instrument calibration
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Standardize instrument, illuminant, observer, backing and calibration
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Use documented measurement procedure and visual master panel
Colour_Variation.Verification: Repeatable measurement and agreed visual correlation

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Parts from different oven positions differ
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Hot/cold spots; airflow; sensor error; loading
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Profile multiple positions and part locations; compare oven mapping
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Balance oven and loading; repair sensor/airflow issue

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Shade changes when production speed changes
Colour_Variation.Likely causes: Different PMT/time; film thickness; transfer efficiency
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Record line speed, PMT, thickness and color at each setting
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Validate speed window using profile and approved panel

Colour_Variation.Visible symptom: Stored powder differs from fresh powder
Colour_Variation.Diagnostic checks: Compare stored and fresh samples; review storage history
Colour_Variation.Corrective actions: Improve storage; follow supplier disposition; avoid mixing unapproved material

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: What substrate is being coated?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Substrate affects pretreatment, heat-up, outgassing and appearance

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: What powder chemistry/system is used?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Cure and performance depend on formulation

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: What is the product code and batch/lot?
What is the nominal cure schedule on the TDS?
Is the stated schedule based on PMT?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Separates oven air temperature from metal temperature

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: What is the thickest section and its approximate thickness?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Mass and thickness affect heat-up rate

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: What is the thinnest section?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Thin areas may overbake while thick areas are still heating
Diagnostic_Questions.Follow-up / rule use: Profile both thin and thick points

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: Was the part metal temperature recorded?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Controller temperature does not prove part temperature
Diagnostic_Questions.Follow-up / rule use: Ask for profile or recommend profiling

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: Where is the defect located?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Location distinguishes geometry, airflow and cure gradients

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: When does the problem first appear?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Separates application, oven and post-cure issues

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: Is the issue on virgin powder, reclaim, or both?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Identifies recovery contamination and powder condition

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: What is the measured film thickness?
What is the booth humidity and compressed-air condition?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Moisture affects flow, feed and defects

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: Has equipment been cleaned after shade change?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Cross-contamination is a common color/appearance cause

Diagnostic_Questions.Question: What test failed and by which method?
Diagnostic_Questions.Why it matters: Test method and substrate determine interpretation

Cure_Profiles.IMPORTANT: ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL ONLY: 1. Show these curves only as an educational illustration of why material/thickness changes heat-up time.
2. Ask user to enter actual measured profiler data.
3. Compare actual profile against the selected product TDS cure window.
4. Flag thin areas for possible overbake and thick/slow areas for possible undercure.
5. Never use this model to set an oven temperature, line speed or cure recipe.

Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Scenario: Thin aluminium + thick steel in same load
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What can happen: Thin area may reach target quickly and receive excess total heat while thick steel is still heating
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What to measure: PMT at thin and thick locations; color/gloss; thickness
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Typical diagnostic direction: Profile both locations; evaluate load segregation or staged approach
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Do not assume: Do not use oven controller temperature as proof of cure

Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What can happen: Rapid heat-up; greater risk of total thermal exposure/overbake if cycle is too long
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What to measure: PMT and time above target; color/gloss
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Typical diagnostic direction: Check upper exposure limit and product-specific cure window
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Do not assume: Do not reduce cure below product requirement without validation

Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What can happen: Slow heat-up; thick core or shielded area may remain undercured
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What to measure: PMT at thickest/slowest location; line speed; load mass
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Typical diagnostic direction: Start cure dwell only after required PMT is reached
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Do not assume: Do not start timer merely when part enters oven

Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What can happen: Outgassing, blisters and slow heat-up may coexist
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What to measure: Porosity, moisture, preheat profile, thickness, film build
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Do not assume: Do not assume pinholes are only a powder defect

Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What can happen: Surface chemistry and outgassing/pretreatment may affect adhesion and appearance
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Typical diagnostic direction: Use validated galvanized preparation and product system
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Do not assume: Do not copy a mild-steel pretreatment blindly

Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.What can happen: Different areas have different heat histories
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Typical diagnostic direction: Use slowest critical location for cure verification and check hottest location for overbake
Cure_Diagnostic_Matrix.Do not assume: Do not use one probe on an easy-to-heat area only

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Uneven, wave-like texture that resembles orange skin; may be intentional texture or an application/flow defect.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Wavy reflected highlights, roughness across the film, stronger appearance at high film build.
Visual_Guide.Common confusions: Intentional textured finish; substrate roughness; dry spray.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Confirm product finish specification, measure DFT at multiple points, review PMT and cure window, inspect substrate profile.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: Do not label a textured product as defective without comparing it with the approved standard.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Circular depressions or crater-like openings where the coating pulls away from a small area.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Round low spots, often with a raised rim; recurring pattern may indicate contamination or incompatibility.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Check compressed air/oil/water contamination, silicone or lubricant sources, booth cleanliness, substrate contamination and reclaim segregation.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: A crater alone does not prove one specific contaminant; confirm with controlled panels and contamination tracing.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Small holes or pores through or within the film, sometimes visible only under angled light or after exposure testing.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Discrete pin-sized openings, often clustered or associated with outgassing, contamination or entrapped gas.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Inspect substrate porosity, preheat/outgassing history, film thickness, degassing grade, pretreatment residues and cure ramp.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: Pinholes may originate in the substrate rather than the powder film.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Raised bubbles or domes in the cured coating, sometimes with a hollow or ruptured center.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Raised areas, clusters after heating or corrosion exposure, possible moisture or gas source.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Check substrate moisture, pretreatment rinsing/drying, trapped gas, corrosion products, cure profile and film thickness.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: Do not puncture or sand unknown defects before recording evidence and following site controls.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Film looks dry, sandy or insufficiently fused, with limited leveling and weak visual uniformity.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Rough texture, low gloss, thin edges or powdery feel before full cure verification.
Visual_Guide.Common confusions: Orange peel; under-cure; intentional matt finish.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Check gun-to-part distance, voltage/current, powder delivery, substrate temperature, film thickness and cure PMT.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: A rough appearance alone cannot distinguish formulation, application and cure causes.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Localized starburst-like roughness, small craters or unstable deposition caused by excessive electrostatic charge.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Defect concentrated at corners, high-build areas or regions with poor charge dissipation.
Visual_Guide.Common confusions: Craters; poor grounding; excessive film build.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Verify part grounding, gun settings, current limits, distance, powder output and booth recovery conditions.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: Do not increase voltage automatically; follow equipment limits and grounding checks.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Edges, corners or sharp features show visibly lower coverage than broad faces.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Exposed or thin-looking edge lines, early corrosion at edges, or visibly different gloss.
Visual_Guide.Common confusions: Poor grounding; Faraday cage effect; insufficient powder output.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Measure edge and face DFT separately, inspect gun angle and movement, verify part orientation and grounding.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: Do not compensate only by excessive overall film build.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Coated part appears different from the approved standard under one or more lighting/viewing conditions.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Difference in hue, lightness, chroma, gloss or texture; variation may change with angle and light source.
Visual_Guide.Common confusions: Gloss variation; metamerism; thickness effect; substrate show-through.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Compare under controlled lighting, confirm standard and batch, measure DFT/gloss/colour, verify cure history and substrate.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: Visual comparison under uncontrolled lighting is not sufficient for final acceptance.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Different areas of the same part or different parts show visible differences in reflected shine.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Patchy gloss, edge-to-face difference, or gloss shift between batches or cure conditions.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Measure gloss at controlled angle, compare DFT, PMT, dwell, substrate and powder batch; check surface contamination.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: Gloss should be compared against the agreed product specification and measurement method.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.

Visual_Guide.Visual description: Coating lifts, peels, flakes or separates from the substrate or between coating layers.
Visual_Guide.Look for: Clean separation, peeling edges, exposed substrate, corrosion underfilm or cohesive film failure.
Visual_Guide.Common confusions: Impact damage; corrosion blistering; intercoat failure.
Visual_Guide.First checks: Review pretreatment, cleaning, rinse quality, substrate condition, cure, contamination and cross-hatch/adhesion results.
Visual_Guide.Do not conclude: Adhesion test results must be interpreted using the agreed standard and substrate system.
Visual_Guide.Image policy: Original schematic illustration; add reviewed licensed photo before controlled release.
